# Hypothesis: split bounding box of 8s by full-empty rows/cols into segments; assign colors by relative size order.
def f(gi):
    H,W=len(gi),len(gi[0])
    mask=[[g==8 for g in r] for r in gi]
    rs=[i for i in range(H) if any(mask[i][j] for j in range(W))]
    cs=[j for j in range(W) if any(mask[i][j] for i in range(H))]
    minr,maxr,minc,maxc=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
    # empty row boundaries inside bbox
    zerorows=[r for r in range(minr,maxr+1) if not any(mask[r][j] for j in range(minc,maxc+1))]
    zerocols=[c for c in range(minc,maxc+1) if not any(mask[i][c] for i in range(minr,maxr+1))]
    def segs(zeros,start,end):
        out=[];cur=start
        while cur<=end:
            s=cur
            while cur<=end and cur not in zeros: cur+=1
            out.append((s,cur-1))
        return out
    R=segs(zerorows,minr,maxr); C=segs(zerocols,minc,maxc)
    blocks=[]
    for r1,r2 in R:
        for c1,c2 in C:
            n=sum(mask[r][c] for r in range(r1,r2+1) for c in range(c1,c2+1))
            if n: blocks.append(((r1,r2,c1,c2),n))
    blocks.sort(key=lambda b:-b[1])
    ranks={}
    for k,n in blocks: ranks[k]=next(v for v in sorted(set(ranks.values()),key=int)) if False else 0
    cnt=0
    for k,n in blocks: ranks[k]=cnt; cnt+=1
    for k,n in blocks:
        r1,r2,c1,c2=k
        for i in range(r1,r2+1):
            for j in range(c1,c2+1):
                go[i][j]=(i,j,k)
    # check value mapping later
    return go

def comps_of(gi):
    H,W=len(gi),len(gi[0]); seen=set(); out=[]
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if gi[i][j] and (i,j) not in seen:
                st=[(i,j)]; seen.add((i,j)); c=[]
                while st:
                    p=st.pop()
                    for dr,dc in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        q=(p[0]+dr,p[1]+dc)
                        if 0<=q[0]<H and 0<=q[1]<W and gi[q[0]][q[1]] and q not in seen:
                            seen.add(q); st.append(q)
                    c.append(p)

import json
def diag_downleft(g):
    g=[r[:] for r in g]; H,W=len(g),len(g[0]); res=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
    cells=[(i,j) for i,r in enumerate(g) for j,x in enumerate(r) if x]
    # simulate: each cell slides down-left until blocked
    pos={}; seen=pos
    # place from bottom-left, sliding each
    for i,j in sorted(cells,key=lambda p:p[1]):
        r,c=i,j
        while True:
            nr,nc=r+1,c-1
            if 0<=nr<H and nc>=0 and (nr,nc) not in pos:
                r,c=nr,nc
            else: break
        pos[(r,c)]=(i,j)
    for (r,c),(oi,oj) in pos.items(): res[r][c]=8
    return res
print(json.dumps(diag_downleft(G['Test input'])))
